name: Small Covered Ovoid Jar, the Jar with Short, Flaring Neck, the Lightly Domed Cover with Small, Lotus-Bud-Shaped Knob
dimensions: including cover: H. 14.5 x Diam. 13.7 cm (5 11/16 x 5 3/8 in.)
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；8th century；Monochrome lead-glazed ware: white earthenware with lead-fluxed emerald-green glaze on the exterior and lead-fluxed pale yellow glaze on the interior. Probably from kilns at Luoyang or Gongxian, Henan province.
